source: Traced by hand and by color from USGS NAIP aerial photos (public domain), to fill in what OpenStreetMap doesn't have yet.

unsure.all: The map has this club's 27 holes numbered 1-9 three times with no nine names; Eagle (1-9) and Osprey (10-18) were picked out by matching every hole's par and length to the card, and the lines follow those map holes. Greens drawn as plain ovals (the photo's greens didn't separate by color).
